42	    def forward(self, Q, K, mask=None):
43	        Q = self.ln1(Q)
44	        K = self.ln1(K)
45	        q = self.fc_q(Q).view(Q.size(0), Q.size(1), self.num_heads, self.dim_V // self.num_heads)
46	        k = self.fc_k(K).view(K.size(0), K.size(1), self.num_heads, self.dim_V // self.num_heads)
47	        v = self.fc_v(K).view(K.size(0), K.size(1), self.num_heads, self.dim_V // self.num_heads)
48	        q = q.permute(0, 2, 1, 3)  # (B, H, Lq, D/H)
49	        k = k.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)  # (B, H, D/H, Lk)
50	        v = v.permute(0, 2, 1, 3)  # (B, H, Lk, D/H)
51	        att = torch.matmul(q, k) / math.sqrt(self.dim_V // self.num_heads)
52	        if mask is not None:
53	            # mask: (B, Lk) -> (B, 1, 1, Lk)
54	            mask = mask.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(1)
55	            att = att.masked_fill(mask == 0, -1e9)
56	        att = torch.softmax(att, dim=-1)
57	        att = self.dropout(att)
58	        out = torch.matmul(att, v)  # (B, H, Lq, D/H)
59	        out = out.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous()  # (B, Lq, H, D/H)
60	        out = out.view(out.size(0), out.size(1), self.dim_V)  # (B, Lq, D)
61	        out = self.fc_o(out)
62	        out = self.ln2(Q + self.dropout(out))
63	        return out

149	    def _process_peaks(self, peaks, mask):
150	        """
151	        将归一化后的peaks转换为(unique_ppm, intensities)
152	        peaks: (B, L, 1) - 归一化的ppm值，包含重复
153	        mask: (B, L) - 1表示有效峰，0表示padding
154	        返回:
155	        unique_ppm: (B, L_unique) - 唯一的归一化ppm值
156	        intensities: (B, L_unique) - 对应的强度（重复次数）
157	        valid_mask: (B, L_unique) - 1表示有效峰，0表示padding
158	        """
159	        batch_size, max_len, _ = peaks.shape
160	        device = peaks.device
161	        
162	        # 初始化输出张量
163	        max_unique_peaks = self.max_peaks
164	        unique_ppm = torch.zeros(batch_size, max_unique_peaks, device=device)
165	        intensities = torch.zeros(batch_size, max_unique_peaks, device=device)
166	        valid_mask = torch.zeros(batch_size, max_unique_peaks, device=device, dtype=torch.bool)
167	        
168	        for i in range(batch_size):
169	            # 获取当前样本的有效峰（根据mask）
170	            valid_indices = mask[i].bool()
171	            if not valid_indices.any():
172	                continue
173	            
174	            batch_peaks = peaks[i, valid_indices, 0]  # (num_valid_peaks,)
175	            
176	            # 将归一化ppm转换为字符串以便统计（避免浮点精度问题）
177	            rounded_peaks = torch.round(batch_peaks * 10000) / 10000.0
178	            
179	            # 统计每个ppm值的出现次数（强度）
180	            unique_vals, counts = torch.unique(rounded_peaks, return_counts=True, sorted=False)
181	            
182	            # 按ppm值排序（从大到小，符合NMR习惯）
183	            sorted_indices = torch.argsort(unique_vals, descending=True)
184	            unique_vals = unique_vals[sorted_indices]
185	            counts = counts[sorted_indices]
186	            
187	            # 限制最大峰数
188	            num_peaks_to_use = min(len(unique_vals), max_unique_peaks)
189	            
190	            # 填充unique_ppm和intensities
191	            unique_ppm[i, :num_peaks_to_use] = unique_vals[:num_peaks_to_use]
192	            intensities[i, :num_peaks_to_use] = counts[:num_peaks_to_use].float()
193	            valid_mask[i, :num_peaks_to_use] = True
194	        
195	        return unique_ppm, intensities, valid_mask

197	    def forward(self, peaks, mask=None):
198	        """
199	        peaks: (B, L, 1) - 归一化的ppm序列，包含重复（重复次数=强度）
200	        mask: (B, L) - 1表示有效峰，0表示padding
201	        返回: (B, L_unique, d_model) - 峰特征编码
202	        """
203	        if peaks is None:
204	            return None
205	
206	        if mask is None:
207	            # 如果没有提供mask，根据peaks是否为0创建mask
208	            mask = (peaks.abs() > 1e-6).all(-1).long()
209	        
210	        # 1. 预处理：将归一化peaks转换为(unique_ppm, intensities)对
211	        unique_ppm, intensities, valid_mask = self._process_peaks(peaks, mask)
212	        # unique_ppm shape: (B, L_unique) - 已归一化的ppm值 [0,1]
213	        # intensities shape: (B, L_unique) - 强度值
214	        
215	        batch_size, num_unique_peaks = unique_ppm.shape
216	        
217	        # 2. 创建输入特征: [ppm, intensity]
218	        features = torch.stack([unique_ppm, intensities], dim=-1)  # (B, L_unique, 2)
219	        
220	        # 3. 输入投影
221	        X = self.input_proj(features)  # (B, L_unique, d_model)
222	        
223	        # 4. 应用mask：将padding位置替换为pad_token
224	        pad_mask = ~valid_mask  # True表示需要padding的位置
225	        
226	        # 5. Set Transformer编码（多层ISAB）
227	        for i, isab_layer in enumerate(self.isab_layers):
228	            X = isab_layer(X, mask=pad_mask if pad_mask.any() else None)
229	        
230	        # 6. （可选）PMA获取全局表示
231	        global_repr = None
232	        global_repr = self.pma(X, mask=pad_mask if pad_mask.any() else None)  # (B, num_seeds, d_model)
233	        
234	        # 7. 输出投影
235	        X = self.output_proj(X)  # (B, L_unique, d_model)
236	        
237	        return X, global_repr, valid_mask

387	class FusionLayer(nn.Module):
388	    """
389	    融合层，同时返回特征和对应的attention mask
390	    支持多种输入组合：
391	    1. 仅局部特征 (z_c, z_h)
392	    2. 仅全局特征 (global_c, global_h)
393	    3. 仅formula指导 (z_guidance)

397	        super().__init__()
398	        self.d_model = d_model

400	    def forward(self, z_c=None, z_h=None, global_c=None, global_h=None, z_guidance=None,
401	                c_mask=None, h_mask=None):
402	        """
403	        Args:
404	            z_c: (B, L_c, d_model) - C-NMR特征（可选）
405	            z_h: (B, L_h, d_model) - H-NMR特征（可选）
406	            global_c: (B, num_seeds_c, d_model) - C-NMR全局特征（可选）
407	            global_h: (B, num_seeds_h, d_model) - H-NMR全局特征（可选）
408	            z_guidance: (B, 1, d_model) - 化学式指导特征（可选）
409	            c_mask: (B, L_c) - C-NMR的mask，1表示有效，0表示padding（可选）
410	            h_mask: (B, L_h) - H-NMR的mask，1表示有效，0表示padding（可选）
411	        Returns:
412	            z_all: (B, L_total, d_model) - 融合后的特征
413	            attention_mask: (B, L_total) - 对应的attention mask，1表示有效，0表示padding
414	        """
415	        # 检查是否有任何有效输入
416	        has_local_features = (z_c is not None) or (z_h is not None)
417	        has_global_features = (global_c is not None) or (global_h is not None)
418	        has_guidance = z_guidance is not None
419	        
420	        if not (has_local_features or has_global_features or has_guidance):
421	            raise ValueError("No input features provided! Need at least one of: "
422	                            "local features (z_c/z_h), global features (global_c/global_h), or guidance (z_guidance)")
423	        
424	        all_features = []
425	        all_masks = []
426	        batch_size = None
427	        device = None
428	        
429	        # 确定batch_size和device
430	        for tensor in [z_c, z_h, global_c, global_h, z_guidance]:
431	            if tensor is not None:
432	                batch_size = tensor.size(0)
433	                device = tensor.device
434	                break
435	        
436	        if batch_size is None:
437	            raise ValueError("Cannot determine batch size from inputs")
438	        
439	        # 1. 处理局部特征 (z_c, z_h)
440	        if z_c is not None:
441	            all_features.append(z_c)
442	            if c_mask is not None:
443	                all_masks.append(c_mask)
444	            else:
445	                all_masks.append(torch.ones(z_c.shape[:2], dtype=torch.long, device=device))
446	        
447	        if z_h is not None:
448	            all_features.append(z_h)
449	            if h_mask is not None:
450	                all_masks.append(h_mask)
451	            else:
452	                all_masks.append(torch.ones(z_h.shape[:2], dtype=torch.long, device=device))
453	        
454	        # 2. 处理全局特征 (global_c, global_h)
455	        if global_c is not None:
456	            all_features.append(global_c)
457	            # 全局特征通常都是有效的
458	            all_masks.append(torch.ones(global_c.shape[:2], dtype=torch.long, device=device))
459	        
460	        if global_h is not None:
461	            all_features.append(global_h)
462	            all_masks.append(torch.ones(global_h.shape[:2], dtype=torch.long, device=device))
463	        
464	        # 3. 处理化学式指导 (z_guidance)
465	        if z_guidance is not None:
466	            all_features.append(z_guidance)
467	            # 化学式guidance通常是有效的
468	            guidance_mask = torch.ones((batch_size, z_guidance.size(1)),
469	                                     dtype=torch.long, device=device)
470	            all_masks.append(guidance_mask)
471	        
472	        # 4. 拼接所有特征和mask
473	        if all_features:
474	            z_all = torch.cat(all_features, dim=1)
475	            attention_mask = torch.cat(all_masks, dim=1) if all_masks else None
476	        else:
477	            # 理论上不会到达这里，因为前面已经检查过
478	            z_all = torch.zeros(batch_size, 0, self.d_model, device=device)
479	            attention_mask = torch.zeros(batch_size, 0, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
480	        
481	        # 5. 确保attention_mask存在（如果没有任何mask，创建全1的mask）
482	        if attention_mask is None or attention_mask.shape[1] == 0:
483	            attention_mask = torch.ones((batch_size, z_all.size(1)),
484	                                       dtype=torch.long, device=device)
485	        
486	        # 6. 验证输出形状
487	        assert z_all.size(0) == batch_size, f"Batch size mismatch: {z_all.size(0)} vs {batch_size}"
488	        assert attention_mask.size(0) == batch_size, f"Mask batch size mismatch: {attention_mask.size(0)} vs {batch_size}"
489	        assert z_all.size(1) == attention_mask.size(1), \
490	            f"Feature and mask length mismatch: {z_all.size(1)} vs {attention_mask.size(1)}"
491	        
492	        return z_all, attention_mask

2	
3	Reference excerpts from the method paper (arXiv:2602.10158, KDD 2026 AI4S
4	Track) and from the encoding workflow documentation. Equation numbers follow
5	the paper.
6	
7	## The nature of NMR data (paper Section 2.1)
8	
9	NMR spectral features are determined by local chemical environments. The
10	ordering of peaks, however, is arbitrary and carries no structural
11	information. Consequently, NMR spectra are naturally modeled as unordered
12	peak sets. Treating spectra as sequences introduces an artificial ordering
13	bias, which can cause predictions to depend on arbitrary indexing rather
14	than chemical attributes. The task instead requires permutation invariance.
15	Let a spectrum be represented as a feature matrix X in R^(n x d), and let Pi
16	denote any n x n permutation matrix that reorders peaks. A valid model f
17	should satisfy
18	
19	    f(Pi X) = f(X),   for all Pi.
20	
21	## Set Transformer primitives (paper Section 2.2)
22	
23	The encoder is built from attention-based blocks designed to process
24	unordered sets (Lee et al., 2019, "Set Transformer: A Framework for
25	Attention-based Permutation-Invariant Neural Networks", ICML).
26	
27	Multihead Attention Block (MAB). MAB is the fundamental building block that
28	generalizes standard attention to interactions between two sets. It takes
29	two input sets X in R^(n x d) and Y in R^(m x d) and performs attention:
30	
31	    H = LayerNorm(X + MultiHeadAttn(X, Y, Y))            (1)
32	    MAB(X, Y) = LayerNorm(H + FFN(H))                    (2)
33	
34	MAB maps the input set X to the queries (Q) and the set Y to both the keys
35	(K) and values (V), so the elements in X query and aggregate information
36	from Y.
37	
38	Set Attention Block (SAB). SAB(X) = MAB(X, X): the set attends to itself.
39	
40	Induced Set Attention Block (ISAB). ISAB introduces a small set of m
41	learnable inducing points I (with m << n) as a low-rank bottleneck:
42	
43	    H = MAB(I, X)                                        (3)
44	    ISAB_m(X) = MAB(X, H)                                (4)
45	
46	In the first step (Q = I, K = V = X), the inducing points summarize global
47	features from the input. In the second step (Q = X, K = V = H), the input X
48	attends only to these summarized features.
49	
50	Pooling by Multihead Attention (PMA). To aggregate a variable-sized set
51	into a fixed-size representation, PMA uses a learnable seed matrix
52	S in R^(k x d) as the query:
53	
54	    PMA_k(X) = MAB(S, X).
55	
56	Since the query S is fixed and independent of the input order, the pooled
57	output is permutation invariant.
58	
59	In summary, Set Transformer constructs expressive set functions by stacking
60	permutation-equivariant attention layers (MAB, SAB, or ISAB) followed by
61	permutation-invariant pooling (PMA).
62	
63	## Problem formulation (paper Section 3.1)
64	
65	Given one-dimensional peak sets from 1H and 13C NMR spectra, optionally
66	accompanied by a molecular formula, the model predicts a molecular structure
67	represented as a canonical SMILES sequence. NMR spectra do not possess
68	meaningful sequential structure: the index of peaks is arbitrary. Chemical
69	information is encoded in the physical coordinate (delta) and other peak
70	attributes, such as splitting patterns and coupling statistics, rather than
71	by the sequential arrangement of input elements. Consequently, the
72	end-to-end mapping must be permutation invariant with respect to peak
73	ordering:
74	
75	    f_theta(Pi_H X_H, Pi_C X_C, F) = f_theta(X_H, X_C, F)   (6)
76	
77	for all permutations Pi_H, Pi_C, ensuring identical molecular predictions
78	for spectra differing only in peak ordering. This invariance is achieved
79	through a composition of permutation-equivariant intermediate layers (ISAB)
80	followed by permutation-invariant aggregation (PMA), enforced at the
81	architectural level rather than through data augmentation.
82	
83	## Spectrum-aware feature engineering (paper Section 3.2)
84	
85	For a 1H NMR spectrum, each peak p_i^H is characterized by
86	
87	    p_i^H = (delta_i, I_i, s_i, j_i)                       (7)
88	
89	where delta_i in [0, 12] ppm denotes the chemical shift (defined as the
90	centroid of the multiplet), I_i the integration intensity, s_i the
91	splitting pattern (e.g., doublet, triplet), and j_i the associated
92	J-coupling constants, sorted and zero-padded to a fixed length (k = 6).
93	
94	For 13C NMR, due to broadband decoupling, each signal appears as a singlet
95	and is described solely by its chemical shift:
96	
97	    p_j^C = delta_j,   delta_j in [0, 220] ppm             (8)
98	
99	as integration values are not quantitatively reliable under broadband
100	decoupling conditions.
101	
102	The input to the model therefore consists of two unordered sets of signal
103	features, P_H = {p_1^H, ..., p_NH^H} and P_C = {p_1^C, ..., p_NC^C}, which
104	are embedded into continuous feature matrices X_H in R^(NH x d) and
105	X_C in R^(NC x d) to serve as inputs for the Set Transformer encoders.
106	
107	## Encoder (paper Section 3.3)
108	
109	The encoder operates on the spectral feature matrices based solely on their
110	chemical attributes, while remaining invariant to any arbitrary ordering.
111	Intermediate spectral representations must satisfy permutation equivariance
112	(f(Pi X) = Pi f(X)) to preserve peak-feature correspondence, while the
113	final pipeline output must be permutation invariant.
114	
115	For each NMR modality, the feature matrix is processed through a Set
116	Transformer block composed of L stacked ISAB layers, followed by Pooling by
117	Multihead Attention:
118	
119	    Z = ISAB_L(X),   G = PMA_k(Z).                        (11)
120	
121	Z in R^(N x d) encodes refined peak-level features, while G in R^(k x d)
122	captures global spectral context. ISAB is permutation-equivariant by
123	construction, while PMA is permutation-invariant with respect to its input
124	set for any k. The global representation G is subsequently consumed by the
125	decoder cross-attention, so it is the channel through which the observed
126	spectrum influences the predicted molecular structure.
127	
128	In the first ISAB stage, inducing points attend to the entire spectrum,
129	compressing the peak set into a small number of latent spectral concepts.
130	In the second stage, individual peaks attend to these latent concepts,
131	refining their representations. The pooled representation must therefore
132	aggregate information from the observed peaks; a pooled representation that
133	does not vary with the observed peaks cannot support structure elucidation.
134
